newsitem.title: USA: Dominick's clerks union reach labor pact.
newsitem.headline: Dominick's clerks union reach labor pact.

text.p: Dominick's Finer Foods Inc said Friday that members of the United Food and Commercial Workers Local 881 and 1540 have ratified a new collective bargaining agreement with the company.
The new agreement covers about 9,300 retail clerks, and has a 40-month term expiring in November 1999.

"Following our recently concluded negotiations with the UFCW Locals 881 and 1540, we are pleased that our employees have ratified this contract, which we believe will enable us to be competitive with all other operators in the Chicago metropolitan area," Robert Mariano, president, said in a statement.
Dominick's is the second largest supermarket operator in the greater Chicago metropolitan area with fiscal 1995 revenues of $2.4 billion.
